Hi {FIRST_NAME}, I built Yieldify (sold to Publicis) and Reachdesk ($225M valuation), and I'm working on my next company in the property space.

We're building {IDEA_PLAIN}. Today that data sits scattered across platforms and teams stitch it all together by hand.

I believe this could be bigger than both my previous companies.

Given your property expertise, I'd love for you to potentially come on as an advisor.

Interested?
